text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ah, is this documentary... could it be from that time?!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah. A close-up feature on an athlete winning back-to-back world championships... It's a rebroadcast of that program.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Wah, brings back memories! Fufu, this really takes me back~
choice_data_list: You seem to be having fun. Is it that interesting of a show?
You seem to be having fun. Is it that interesting of a show?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, definitely. It's a program filled with memories for both of us!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed. Ever since that incident, you started talking to me quite often.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Before that, we hardly talked much at all, after all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: You were always training silently in the room... and I thought you might not have an interest in anything outside of racing.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So... fufu. Yes, it all started with that event—

text_block_list.name: Crown's Friend
text_block_list.text: Wah, it started~! My fave is making their first appearance on this music show! Ah~ you have no idea how long I've been waiting for this day~

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Duramente-san? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
............
...Could it be you wanted to watch the TV?

text_block_list.name: Crown's Friend
text_block_list.text: Eh?! Duramente-senpai?! S-Sorry, I didn't notice! Please, go right ahead!!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: No, it's fine. ...You were watching first.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Perhaps I should have asked my sister to record it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: So there really was a program you wanted to watch.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Um, if you don't mind, could you tell me the name of the show?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Catch-up streaming on the internet... That was a blind spot. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Not at all! I often use it to watch various language learning programs myself.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Still, your intensity earlier, Duramente-san... caught me by surprise. Was it that important of a show?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...I needed to see this feature story no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: A top athlete who conquers the world stage. Their mindset will undoubtedly serve as nourishment.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...No, I must make it nourishment.

text_block_list.name: Satono Relative
text_block_list.text: The greatest contribution the Satono family must make to the racing world: "to produce a horse girl who can win a GⅠ." Please—make it a reality.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Leave it to me! A "crown" worthy of the Satono name—I will definitely win it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...I see. So you're carrying the same thing, too—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, Duramente-san! Mind if I watch the show with you? And then we can talk about our impressions!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I really want to get to know more about you.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ever since then, we started talking like this a lot, right?
choice_data_list: There was a time like that...
There was a time like that, huh...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Strangely enough, it feels like a very long time ago.
